_comment: Example/reference bake-off profile for license-plate detection. Opt-in: nothing loads it unless you select it by path (--profile examples/bakeoff/license_plate/profile.json, or OP_BAKEOFF_PROFILE=/app/examples/bakeoff/license_plate/profile.json in a container that mounts examples/ at /app/examples). triton_model is intentionally empty -- set it (or pass --triton-model) to the plate detector your Triton server actually serves.
name: license_plate
description: Single license_plate class; vehicle->plate crop mode via COCO vehicle classes
